parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to which the channel belongs. The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 频道所属的应用 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to which the user to be transcoded belongs. The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 待转码用户所属的频道 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符
parameters.name: channel_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the subscribed video input stream. This parameter is valid only when the subscribed media type includes a video stream. Valid values:

0: Camera. This is the default value.
1: Screen sharing. This value is not supported and takes no effect
fields.help_zh:
订阅的视频输入流类型，仅订阅媒体类型包含视频流有效。取值：

0（默认值）：摄像头。
1：屏幕共享。（暂不支持，设置无效）
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The media type of the subscribed user. Valid values:

0: Original stream, which includes both audio and video streams. This is the default value.
1: Audio stream only. This value is not supported and takes no effect.
2: Video stream only. This value is not supported and takes no effect
fields.help_zh:
订阅用户的媒体类型。取值：

0（默认值）：原始流，包含音频与视频流。
1：仅音频流。（暂不支持，设置无效）
2：仅视频流。（暂不支持，设置无效）
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the subscribed user
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The input parameters for single-stream subscription
fields.name: single_sub_user_param

parameters.help_en: The parameters related to subscription input
parameters.name: input_param

fields.help_en: The ID of the channel to which the transcoded stream is pushed. The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Pushing streams to a different channel is not supported, and this setting takes no effect
fields.help_zh: 转码流转推到的频道ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。（暂不支持转推到不同的频道，设置无效）
fields.name: channel_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the transcoding template. Valid values:

alimcopy
lld
lsd
lhd
lud
fields.help_zh:
转码模板名。取值：

alimcopy
lld
lsd
lhd
lud
fields.name: transcode_template

fields.help_en: The ID of the user that pushes the transcoded stream to the channel. Make sure that the user ID is different from the IDs of other users in the channel
fields.help_zh: 转码流转推到频道的用户ID，需保证与频道内其它用户ID不同
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The user token required for pushing the transcoded stream to the channel. For more information, see Token-based authentication (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/live/token-based-authentication)
fields.help_zh: 转码流转推到频道所需的用户Token，详见Token鉴权 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/live/token-based-authentication)
fields.name: user_token

parameters.help_en: The parameters related to transcoding output
parameters.name: output_params

parameters.help_en: The idle timeout period. If the task remains idle (fails to subscribe to the specified streamer stream) for a duration exceeding this period, the task automatically stops. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 10 to 14400, which is up to 4 hours. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh:
空闲超时时间，当任务处于空闲状态（订阅不到指定主播流）的时长超过一定时间会自动停止。
单位为秒，范围须在[10,14400]内，即最大 4 小时，默认为 300 秒
parameters.name: max_idle_time
